Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

MENLO: From Preferences to Proficiency -- Evaluating and Modeling Native-like Quality Across 47 Languages (2509.26601v1) · paper method: Each generated response pair is shown in randomized order and rated by at least three annotators.

cohort7.claim.menlo.annotation

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report; experiments, raw datasets, consent forms, labor records and formal derivations were not independently reproduced or audited.
  • Responses use GPT-4o, Llama4-Maverick, Llama4-Maverick with Search and Gemini1.5 with Search; 1–5 Likert ratings allow ties and final scores use majority vote. Expert annotators provide language-specific feedback and subset gold labels.
